theorem.classical_estimator: Sample indexed constant-support terms, multiply permutations, and test the return event; Hoeffding costs O(epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)).
theorem.complexity_consequence: Polynomial word length and inverse-polynomial additive signal give a polynomial classical estimator, even when branching blocks are huge.
theorem.hidden_even_trace_identity: The h-even source trace is the probability that the same product equals either identity or the reference hidden involution h.
theorem.regular_trace_identity: tr_reg(product_j D_(h_j)) is the probability that independent uniform orbit terms multiply to identity.
theorem.scope_limit: Does not recover an unknown matching or estimate conditioned matrix transition blocks and coherent all-copy target interference.
